tutorial_instructions.en: Change topology, pitch or length; inspect gaps, arc lengths and copper volume. Geometry is a model input.
tutorial_instructions.zh-CN: 修改结构、节距或长度；检查间隙、弧长与铜体积。几何是场模型的输入。

fixed_conventions: SI; exp(+j omega t); RMS; sigma=58 MS/m; mu_r=1; 20 C

en: A topology maps a persistent strand identity to a centerline (xi(z),yi(z),z). The tutorial samples the path, evaluates surface gaps and integrates each arc length ℓi=∫√(1+x′i²+y′i²)dz.
For axially cut length L, copper volume is ΣAiℓi and common-terminal Rdc=(ΣσAi/ℓi)⁻¹. Equal nominal copper area does not remove arc-length growth or change terminal constraints.

Geometry supplies the subsequent field model. Performance ranking requires an independent electromagnetic solve, controlled return/end effects and numerical uncertainty, using traditional multilevel Litz as a strong baseline.
zh-CN: 结构把持续不变的股线身份映射到中心线 (xi(z),yi(z),z)。教程采样路径，检查表面间隙，并积分弧长 ℓi=∫√(1+x′i²+y′i²)dz。
轴向长度 L 对应铜体积 ΣAiℓi，共端直流电阻为 Rdc=(ΣσAi/ℓi)⁻¹。名义铜面积相等仍须计入弧长增长，并保持一致的端接约束。
几何为后续场模型提供输入。性能排名须独立电磁场解、受控回流与端区及数值不确定性；传统多级 Litz 是强基线。
